question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (2)
solution:
The correct answer is: **grasp**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"grasp"** means to seize and hold firmly; it can also mean to comprehend or understand something. (पकड़ना, समझना)

 
 
• **Example: **She struggled to grasp the complex mathematical concept.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that lion's long canines are used to seize and devour their prey. 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word to fill the blank is **"grasp"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **grasp**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Host** (मेज़बान): A person who receives or entertains guests.

 
 
• **Example:** The host greeted us warmly at the entrance.
 
 
 
• **Loathe** (घृणा करना): Feel intense dislike or disgust for.
 
 
• **Example: **She loathes the idea of eating raw fish.
 
 
 
• **Remiss** (लापरवाह): Lacking care or attention to duty; negligent.
 
 
• **Example:** He was remiss in his duties and often missed important deadlines.
